what: Regions Financial is a regional bank based in Birmingham, Alabama, with branches across the South, Midwest and Texas. It does consumer and commercial banking plus wealth management and capital markets.
customers: Households and small businesses across fifteen southern and midwestern states, and corporate clients nationally.
money: deposits, mortgages, car and consumer lending
commercial lending, treasury management and capital markets
moat: Deposit share across southern markets where population and business growth are above the national average, providing cheap and stable funding.
risks: Commercial property lending is a watched exposure across regional banking
Deposit costs rise when savers move to higher-yielding accounts
Fraud-related losses hurt results in a recent year
Regional bank capital rules are being tightened
opportunities: Revenue grew about 6% last year with a 29% net margin
Its southern footprint grows faster than the national average
A dividend yield above 4% with consistent buybacks
watch: Net interest margin and commercial property credit metrics.
